The opinion is centrally about Miranda warnings: certiorari was granted to decide whether telling a suspect counsel would be appointed “if and when you go to court” renders Miranda warnings inadequate.

The Court applied Miranda and Prysock, held the warnings satisfied Miranda, and the lake record shows SCOTUS status plus substantial progeny metrics, supporting the editorial role Key — Progeny for a Miranda and custodial interrogation home.
